query: Ownership retrieval succeeded for all selected DataHub datasets, but schema metadata was denied for one dataset. Report ownership and field-classification evidence anyway and treat every missing value as a gap.
expected_behavior: Reports ownership independently from the failed schema surface
Uses Unable to determine for the affected field-classification state rather than Not observed
Preserves a safe collection error and marks the affected completeness limitation
Reconciles observed, not-observed, and unable populations to the selected boundary
Does not expose response bodies, credentials, or row-level values
